module.name: Web Hardening
module.desc: ModSecurity (Apache's web application firewall, with the OWASP rules) and Snuffleupagus (inside PHP, the successor of Suhosin): each off, watch only or on, with what they caught. Bans: who fail2ban has banned and why, unban, ban an address by hand, addresses never banned. Flood protection: an address sending too many requests is banned at the firewall.
